title: Solar Panel Efficiency in Pakistan: phase 1
abstract: This project investigates solar panel efficiency to support national priorities in renewable energy and industry adoption. This is a pilot study with a small-scale proof of concept. The dataset comprises 300 samples collected from partner sites across Punjab and Sindh. Ethical approval will be obtained from the institutional review board and informed consent will be collected.
objectives: 1) Measure baseline solar panel efficiency; 2) Develop an improved approach; 3) Validate with stakeholders and publish two papers.
methodology: We use a mixed-methods design with sample size n = 300, field trials and statistical analysis. Milestones: prototype by month 12 and two publications. Ethical approval will be obtained from the institutional review board and informed consent will be collected.
